description: This source file defines the AppSyncClient class for interacting with the AWS AppSync service in PHP. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to AppSync, acting as a client wrapper extending the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: AppSyncClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS AppSync service, providing methods for API operations.

methods.name: associateApi
methods.description: Associates an API with AWS AppSync.

methods.name: associateApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an API with AWS AppSync.

methods.name: createApi
methods.description: Creates a new AWS AppSync API.

methods.name: createApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new AWS AppSync API.

methods.name: deleteApi
methods.description: Deletes an existing AWS AppSync API.

methods.name: deleteApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing AWS AppSync API.

methods.name: evaluateCode
methods.description: Evaluates code within the AppSync context.

methods.name: evaluateCodeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates code within the AppSync context.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific AppSync API.

methods.name: getApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a specific AppSync API.

methods.name: updateApiAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing AppSync API.

methods.name: startSchemaMerge
methods.description: Starts a schema merge operation in AppSync.

methods.name: startSchemaMergeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a schema merge operation in AppSync.
